title: MergeResponse
description: The merge commit and how it landed, or that the slice's branch was already merged. A merge that does not land is refused with a sentence, and nothing changes anywhere.

oneOf.description: The slice's branch was merged with a merge commit.

how.description: The slice's branch was merged with a merge commit.

into.description: The branch it was merged into.

commit.description: The merge commit, in full. Its parents are the branch's old head and the slice's head.

landed.description: How the merge commit landed. branch-not-checked-out: the branch is checked out nowhere, and it was moved in a worktree of the mode's own. checked-out-branch-fast-forwarded: the project's own folder has the branch checked out; the merge commit was made in a worktree of the mode's own, then the branch was fast-forwarded to it and the folder's files are the merge commit's.

oneOf.description: The slice's branch was already merged, so no commit was made.

how.description: The slice's branch was already merged, so no commit was made.

into.description: The branch it was merged into.

commit.description: The head of the branch it was merged into, unchanged, in full.
